boundaries.name: Simulated device/tag to ingestion
boundaries.untrusted_side: API/CLI caller and simulated device inputs
boundaries.data_crossing: Animal identifier, event type, timestamps, telemetry and identifiers
boundaries.authentication_assumptions: Local API has no application authentication; default loopback bind is a deployment boundary only.
boundaries.integrity_assumptions: Input validation/canonicalization in backend; caller is not a trusted signer.
boundaries.confidentiality_requirements: Animal and movement records should remain local and access-controlled.
boundaries.possible_abuse: Malformed/oversized values, identifier injection, unauthorized writes if network-exposed.
boundaries.mitigations: Typed request validation, domain validation and loopback default.
boundaries.residual_risk: No auth for externally bound API; deployment must restrict access.

boundaries.name: Backend to SQLite persistence
boundaries.untrusted_side: Caller-provided values and pre-existing/corrupted DB contents
boundaries.data_crossing: Event fields, JSON payload, IDs, paths/config and publication state
boundaries.authentication_assumptions: OS process/user boundary; no DB-level authentication.
boundaries.integrity_assumptions: Parameterized SQL and Event V1 hash verification; hashes are unkeyed.
boundaries.possible_abuse: SQL injection, malformed persisted JSON, duplicate keys, direct DB tampering.
boundaries.mitigations: Parameterized queries; strict event payload parser; chain verification and outbox binding.
boundaries.residual_risk: Local DB writer can read data and recompute unkeyed chain hashes.

boundaries.name: Outbox to local signer file
boundaries.trusted_side: Validated publication workflow and signer library
boundaries.untrusted_side: Filesystem path, file contents and local filesystem actors
boundaries.data_crossing: Private key bytes and unsigned/signed transaction data
boundaries.authentication_assumptions: Local OS identity/permissions; no HSM or key service.
boundaries.integrity_assumptions: File descriptor pinned during read, no-follow when supported, key format validated.
boundaries.confidentiality_requirements: Signer secret must be owner-only/private and never logged or persisted to evidence.
boundaries.possible_abuse: Symlink substitution, permissive mode, special file blocking, malformed/trailing key, path race.
boundaries.mitigations: O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK where supported, fstat regular file, POSIX owner/mode check, bounded read, sanitized exceptions.
boundaries.residual_risk: Native Windows ACL enforcement and hostile concurrent filesystem modification not tested.

boundaries.name: Adapter to RPC provider
boundaries.trusted_side: Local adapter response validation and configured chain/network invariants
boundaries.untrusted_side: RPC transport/provider and returned JSON/receipt data
boundaries.data_crossing: Chain ID, genesis/code, tx identifiers, signed tx, receipts and logs
boundaries.authentication_assumptions: TLS for HTTPS endpoints; local loopback exception for EVM tests.
boundaries.integrity_assumptions: Response structure, chain, contract/code, signature/tx hash and receipt fields are checked.
boundaries.confidentiality_requirements: RPC URLs may contain credentials only where configuration permits; avoid logging values.
boundaries.possible_abuse: Wrong network, malformed/duplicate JSON, forged/stale receipt, target mismatch, replay/duplicate dispatch.
boundaries.mitigations: Fail-closed config validation and strict adapter receipt checks; Solana returned signature bound to request.
boundaries.residual_risk: Provider correctness and TLS trust remain external; no public RPC attack simulation.

boundaries.name: EVM adapter to smart contract
boundaries.untrusted_side: Public transaction callers and chain state
boundaries.integrity_assumptions: Contract checks publisher, nonzero commitment and duplicate commitment; logs emitted on successful registration.
boundaries.confidentiality_requirements: Commitment only; source records remain off-chain.
boundaries.possible_abuse: Unauthorized caller, duplicate registration, replay, unexpected state mutation or upgrade admin.
boundaries.mitigations: Access control and one-time mapping; no upgrade/admin/external calls in reviewed contract.
boundaries.residual_risk: No Slither/Forge available; reviewed source and tested local EVM only.
